x: New member John Dudman was another to run well, opening his account quite promisingly. A close handicap win went to Alan Mead who, amidst the mud, managed to rise above his regular rivals.
John Dudman improved again to take the handicap but really congratulations should go to every man who finished.

JOHN DUDMAN only appeared on the Belgrave scene just over a year ago but has soon become a popular member of the Duke's Joggers. He is off now for a spell in Australia but hopes to return before the end of the summer.
Howard Satchell continued his come-back of all come-backs and a hirsute John Dudman seemed to have lost little of his form after taking time off to visit Australia.
